text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen has
finally
arrived!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The real race is between the
Otherworldly
Front-Runner, Silence
Suzuka, and the Empress,
Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka was incredible in the Kinko Sho! I
wonder
if she'll be able to take first
today too.
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
But Эйр Грув's a genius on the track.
There's no
beating her! Have you seen
her final dash in the
homestretch
before?
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
You're so right! Man, I can't wait for this
race to
start!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text:
Between Сайленс Судзука's display in the
Kinko Sho
and Эйр Грув's
overwhelming skill, the
excitement for
this race from the crowd is
palpable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well... there isn't much left to say.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I'll see you on the track!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
